EmailTemplate.name: GRAD - Has ASU received my transcripts?
EmailTemplate.subject: How to know if ASU has received your transcripts
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Graduate Admission Services. If you have sent documents to our office, please allow seven business days for the documents to be received and processed. As soon as we process your documents, we will update your status My ASU.
Thank you,
Graduate Admission Services
If you have additional questions related to this, please reply to this email.
